workstreams.Business Plan Execution: Deliver reliable business systems, efficient licensing, service operations and capability access consistent with approved business requirements.
workstreams.Blueprint Detailing (L4/L5): Detail functions, operating models, data and procedure governance interfaces and service responsibilities across internal and partner teams.
workstreams.Digitization & Automation: Integrate Oracle and business platforms; stabilize and progressively develop Tekwin, including approved AI capabilities.
workstreams.Implementation: Implement approved operating arrangements, security controls, service ownership, user access and change management.
workstreams.Offshoring: Use Jordan and partner capabilities to scale specialist development and selected operations while retaining core internal competence.
workstreams.Sub-Objectives Execution: Support the relevant sub-objectives, including measurable cost and service outcomes.

ownerRoles.Direct: Owns operational outputs that directly affect the objective.
ownerRoles.Enable: Provides systems, resources, standards or governance that enable the objective. Complete what the task delivers to the other groups (its contributions).
ownerRoles.Support: Contributes, while the principal result sits with another group. Complete what the task delivers to the other groups (its contributions).

partnerRoles.Enable: The partner provides systems, resources, standards or governance our task needs.
partnerRoles.Support: The partner contributes to our task, while the result stays with us.

needed.Before start: The output is needed before the receiving task can start.
needed.During execution: The output is needed while the receiving task is running.

readiness.Ready to include: The task data is mature enough to include in the Master Plan (not necessarily to start now).
readiness.Needs completion: Something must be completed or resolved first.

dirs.t: Build a sustainable and cost-efficient digitalization operating model
dirs.m: Reduce cost and access specialist capabilities through partners (Alia, Black Smith, SaSa) and capable offshore teams in Jordan, while internal teams own service operations, architecture, critical product knowledge and vendor oversight. Strategic products such as Tekwin need continuing development, maintenance, security and lifecycle ownership.

dirs.t: Integrate Oracle with company applications and optimize license utilization
dirs.m: Capture Oracle's benefits while managing cost and risk; integrate Tekwin and other applications; allocate access and licences by actual responsibility, approved architecture and contract terms. Indirect access or alternative viewing interfaces do not automatically remove Oracle licence obligations.

dirs.t: Develop Tekwin in phases and progressively expand its capabilities
dirs.m: Stabilize Tekwin first, then add suitable AI agents, and evaluate a service-by-service expansion into Unifier functions only where Tekwin offers better integrated business value and the transition is justified and approved.

dirs.t: Activate the ICT Blueprint and integrate it with departmental Blueprints
dirs.m: Activate the Blueprint's roles, procedures and operating model, align them with departmental Blueprints, and turn approved procedures into integrated digital services with clear responsibilities across internal, offshore and partner teams.

dirs.t: Integrate with EPMO on information, data and procedure governance
dirs.m: EPMO is custodian of libraries, approved procedures and common standards; business owners own content; ICT owns architecture, access, integration, security and operations. Clear interfaces for changes, version control and quality checks.

dirs.t: Balance cybersecurity with operational efficiency and flexibility
dirs.m: Cybersecurity requirements for multi-country operations that protect information and systems while keeping teams efficient, mobile and collaborative.

dirs.t: Define & Utilize AI for Digitalization initiatives
Build a scalable multi-country workforce model (sample)
dirs.m: Sample direction for the prototype: staffing rules, role catalogue and hiring for KSA and Jordan operations.

dirs.t: Activate the Finance Blueprint and standard cost structures (sample)
dirs.m: Sample direction for the prototype: standard cost structures and Finance Blueprint processes in daily use.
